artifact: T-02 Ghidra headless smoke test run manifest
purpose: Records the out-of-band facts that analyzeHeadless does not print into its own console stream -- process exit code and wall-clock duration -- so that the class-P claims in ghidra-smoke-test.md section 4.2 rest on a saved artifact and not on session memory. plan.md 10.3 class-P criteria 1 and 2.
schema: none by design -- research/evidence/*/*.json is a schema-free raw evidence extract (tools/kb/validate.py ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_MAP, plan.md 9.2)
captured_by: re-run of the T-02 smoke test to close the debt recorded in ghidra-smoke-test.md section 7

environment.jvm: Temurin JDK 21.0.12.1+1 LTS, D:\Tools\jdk-21, bound via support\launch.properties JAVA_HOME_OVERRIDE

capture_note: stdout and stderr were redirected together into one file so that interleaving is preserved. The raw capture contains literal user-profile paths, the account name and a verbatim machine PATH dump, all forbidden by C-13, so the committed logs are the output of redact-log.py applied to the raw capture. The raw captures are kept outside git under workspace/ghidra-smoke-2026-08-22/ and their sha256 is recorded below so the redaction can be re-verified locally.

log_diff_run1_vs_run2.interpretation: 29 lines on each side; every one of them is a duration line (the per-analyzer table, 'Class search complete', 'Headless startup complete'). No structural difference: same analyzer list, same messages, same order.
log_diff_run1_vs_run2.method: Compare-Object over the two committed logs

grep_audit.lines_containing_Exception_note: the single match is the analyzer name 'Windows x86 PE Exception Handling' in the timing table, not a thrown exception
grep_audit.warn_lines_note: both are NoReturnFunctionAnalyzer reporting that it ignores leading underscores on '___raise_securityfailure' and '___report_rangecheckfailure' from PEFunctionsThatDoNotReturn. Identical in both runs.
